childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_image_alt: Umzali ophethe usana olusanda kuzalwa futhi elubuka
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_1: Lapho izingane zizalwa ukubona kwazo kuba buthakathaka. Ngokuyisisekelo ziba njengezi 'yimpumputhe'. Nokho ukubona kwazo kukhula eminyakeni emi-5 kuya kweyi-8 elandelayo, futhi intuthuko enkulu yenzeka ezinyangeni eziyi-18 zokuqala zokuphila. Lesi isikhathi esibaluleke kakhulu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_intro_paragraph_2: Ngalesi sikhathi uhlelo lokubona lwamehlo nobuchopho kufanele lube luphilile futhi luthole ukuvuselelwa. Lesi yisikhathi esihle kakhulu sokuhlonza isifo nokudlulisela ukuze kutholakale ukwelashwa.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_titl: Kungani futhi kanjani sihlonza isifo ukuze sikhulise ukukhula kokubona kakhulu
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_identify_disease_body: Noma yisiphi isifo seso noma sobuchopho sizobambezela ukukhula futhi sinciphise ukubona kwesikhathi eside. Yingakho kubalulekile ukuhlonza ngokushesha okukhulu noma yiziphi izimbangela zesifo ezingelashwa ezithinta ukukhula okujwayelekile kokubona kanye nokukhula komzimba jikelele.
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_question_bubble: Lokhu kungenziwa ngokubuza imibuzo ngokubona, ukukhulelwa, ukuzalwa, noma yikuphi ukugula kanye nokukhula jikelele
childhoodeyebrainimages.visual_development_observe_copy: Bese ubheka amehlo ukuhlola ukukhula kokubona, bese uhlola isifo samehlo ngokwenza ukuhlolwa kwe fundal 'red' reflex nangokuhlola ingxenye engaphambili yeso
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_paragr: Ngaphakathi esibelethweni, umntwana ongakazalwa uzungezwe umsindo opholile futhi opholile, kuhlanganise nokushaya kwenhliziyo kanina namazwi nomsindo ovela ngaphandle.
Njengoba ukukhulelwa kufinyelela esigabeni sokugcina, amehlo omntwana angavuleka ngaphakathi esibelethweni.
Yize bengakakwazi ukubona izithombe noma imininingwane, bangezwa izinguquko ekukhanyeni.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_1_image_: Umdwebo wesiteji sokukhulelwa wengane engakazalwa esibelethweni
Umfanekiso wesiteji sokukhulelwa sekwephuzile obonisa ukuqaphela ukukhanya
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_2_paragr: Ngesikhathi sokuzalwa, ukubona akufani kakhulu nokomuntu omdala. Ingane esanda kuzalwa 'iyimpumputhe' futhi ingaboni kahle kahle cishe ku-6/600. Abawuboni umbala omningi futhi banokuzwela okungafani okuphansi. Abanayo i-stereovision futhi amehlo abo angase ancinze njalo njalo.

Kodwa-ke bazobuka ngqo ubuso obuseduze kakhulu, bese becindezela amehlo abo ukuze bavale ukukhanya okukhanyayo. Umbono wabo kusukela manje uzokhula ngokushesha okukhulu futhi ube njengomuntu omdala ngeminyaka eyi-8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_3_paragr: Phakathi namasonto amabili umbono usuthuthuke kakhulu. Manje bangabona imininingwane ethile, ikakhulukazi uma izinto ziseduze. Awukho umbala futhi ezikubonayo kuyisicaba, ngoba amehlo azo awakakaqondile ngaso sonke isikhathi futhi asebenza ndawonye ukuze abone ukujula.
Ngezinye izikhathi amehlo abo azokhukhuleka noma aphume isikhashana. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuklolodela. Lokhu kufanele kuyeke ukwenzeka ngezinyanga ezintathu.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_paragr: Ngenyanga eyodwa ukukhanya kombala kuyaqala ukukhula. Bazoba nesithakazelo kakhulu ngokubukeka ikakhulukazi ebusweni. Bazoqala nokuzama ukulandela izinto ezihambayo.
Bazokwazi ngokwengeziwe imisindo ejwayelekile kuhlanganise namazwi aziwayo njengomndeni wabo. Futhi baqale ukuhlanganisa abakuzwayo nabakubonayo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_4_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwamasonto amabili nenyanga eyodwa
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_paragr: Ngezinyanga ezintathu amehlo azo kufanele ahlale eqondile futhi asebenze ndawonye ukuze enze umbono we-3D. Lo mbono omusha ojulile ubasiza ukuba bafinyelele izinto ngokunembe kakhudlwana. Bazokwazi ukulandela izinto ezihamba ngokushesha kodwa kunzima ukushintsha ukulungiswa kusuka ebusweni obunye noma into iye kwenye ngokushesha.
Bathanda ukubuka into eyodwa kuphela ngesikhathi. Bangase futhi baqale ukwenza imisindo yabo yokuqala ezwakalayo.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_5_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwenyanga eyodwa nezintathu
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_6_paragr: Usana olubonayo ngokujwayelekile luzojabula lapho lubona inkomishi yokuphuza noma isipuni futhi lungalungisa futhi lulandele ubuso bubangeni elingamamitha angu-1-2 futhi lukwazi ukuhlukanisa phakathi kobuso obujwayelekile nobungajwayelekile ngabo bobabili ubuso nangamazwi.
Bangaqala nokubona izinto ezikude. Beqhutshwa ilukuluku, bazoqala ukufinyelela izinto.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_7_paragr: Ezinyangeni eziyisi-6 kuye kweziyi-12 ubudala ikhono lokubona liyathuthuka futhi licishe libe ngu-6/36. Ibanga okubukwa ngalo ubuso nokwabonwa linwetshiwe libe ngamamitha angu-2. Zonke izici zokubona ziyathuthuka ngokufinyelela nokubamba okunembe kakhudlwana.

Kule minyaka sebethanda kakhulu izithombe ezisezincwadini nakumabonakude, nakuba izinto zangempela zibakhuthaza kakhulu ukuthi bagaqe futhi ngesikhathi sosuku lwabo lokuzalwa lokuqala, bahambe bebheke ezintweni abazithandayo. Ukubhuqa kwabo kuyakhula, futhi imisindo izoba amagama okuqala nakule minyaka.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_paragr: Ezinyangeni eziyi-18, ukubona sekukhulile impela njengoba kusafiphele kancane ekuhlakanipheni kokubukwa cishe ngo-6/18. Manje bazokwazi ukubona igama labo futhi basebenzise amagama amaningi.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_8_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nambili neziyishumi nesishiyagalombili
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_paragr: Ngemva kwezinyanga ezingu-18 ubudala, ukubona kusadinga iminyaka eminingana ukuvuthwa. I-acuity evamile yabantu abadala izokwakhiwa lapho eneminyaka engu-8.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_9_image_: Ukuthuthukiswa okubonakalayo phakathi kwezinyanga eziyishumi nesishiyagalombili neminyaka eyisishiyagalombili
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_parag: Ngemva kweminyaka engu-8 isistimu yokubuka ingase ingathuthuki kahle ekwelapheni njengokuhlinzwa kwe-cataract. Ngakho-ke ukuhlonzwa kwezifo nokudluliselwa kokwelashwa kwenziwa kangcono kusenesikhathi empilweni.

Kuyabonakala ukuthi ukukhula okukhulu kwenzeka phakathi kokuzalwa nezinyanga eziyi-18 ubudala futhi kuqhubeka kancane kancane kuyo yonke iminyaka yobuntwana. Ngalesi sikhathi kubalulekile ukuthi ingane ibe nempilo enhle futhi ingakwazi ukubona izifo futhi ihlinzekwe ngendawo evuselelayo neyondlayo ngokwemfundo.
Ukuhlonzwa kusenesikhathi kwesifo ngokudluliselwa kokwelashwa kubalulekile ukusiza ukukhulisa kokubili ukukhula okubonakalayo nokujwayelekile.
childhoodeyebrainimages.normal_visual_development_stage_10_image: Ngemuva kweminyaka eyisishiyagalombili umdwebo wokuthuthukiswa kokubukwayo

assessmentVisionPage.cue_001: Le vidiyo ichaza ukuthi ungayilungiselela kanjani ingane nomama noma umnakekeli ngaphambi kokwenza ukuhlolwa kwe-reflex ebomvu kuzo zombili izingane ezisanda kuzalwa kanye nezingane ezindala.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_002: Ingane kufanele ibanjwe ivikelekile kodwa ikhululeke, kungaba ethangeni, phezu kwehlombe, noma, uma usana, ilele ngomhlane.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_003: Kubalulekile ukuthi bazizwe bephephile. Izingane ezincane zingase zingaphumuli futhi zingadinga ukusongwa.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_004: Ukuhlola ngokushesha ngemva kokuphakelwa kungasiza njengoba bezokhululeka futhi balale kancane.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_005: Izingane ezindala zingase zizinze ngokudlala ngethoyizi isikhashana.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_006: Khuluma ngezwi elinobungane futhi uzame ukwehla ufike ezingeni lamehlo abo.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_007: Chaza ukuthi uzokwenzani futhi uthole imvume ngaphambi kokuthi uqale.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_008: Okokuqala, buza umama noma umnakekeli ukuthi kukhona yini okungalungile abakubonile ngeso noma ekuboneni kwengane yabo nokuthi sebeyibonile isikhathi esingakanani inkinga.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_009: Okulandelayo, bheka ubuso namehlo engane. Zibuze imibuzo ethile.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_010: Ingabe ingane ibonakala inobuhlungu kwelinye noma womabili iso? Ingabe amehlo avulekile noma awavale ngokuqinile?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_011: Ingabe kukhona ukuchelela noma ukuphuma emehlweni? Ingabe amehlo alingana? Ingabe amajwabu amehlo avuvukele?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_012: Manje, cabanga ngendlela ingane ebona ngayo. Hambisa ubuso bakho kancane ukusuka kolunye kuya kolunye, ubheke amehlo abo.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_013: Amamatheke athule. Ingabe ingane ilandela ukunyakaza kobuso bakho noma isabela ekumoyizeleni kwakho buthule?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_014: Nalapha, zibuze imibuzo ethile. Ingabe womabili amehlo anyakaza ngokukhululeka futhi ndawonye?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_015: Ingabe amehlo aqondile noma iso elilodwa libheke ngaphakathi noma ngaphandle? Ingabe amehlo ayaxega?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_016: Ungasebenzisa futhi izibani ku-Arclight kanye nokuhlosiwe kwesithombe ukuze uthole ukunakwa nokuhlola ikhwalithi yokubona.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_017: Hambisa uhlangothi oluqondiwe uye ohlangothini, phezulu naphansi. Bheka ukuze ubone ukuthi ingane iyalungisa futhi ilandela ilitshe.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_018: Ingabe bangakwazi ukufinyelela futhi bakhombe ngokunembile lapho okuqondiwe khona?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_019: Ngokuvamile, iso elilodwa kuphela elingakwazi ukubona kahle. Wena noma umama ungakwazi ukuvala iso elilodwa, bese elinye.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_020: Hambisa okuqondiwe bese uqhathanisa indlela ingane eziphatha ngayo lapho isebenzisa womabili amehlo, bese elilodwa ngesikhathi.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_021: Uma ingane ingathandi ukumbozwa kweso elilodwa, lokho kuphakamisa ukuthi iso elingamboziwe aliboni kahle.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_022: Uma ucabanga ukuthi ungabona okuthile okungalungile ngeso langaphandle, bheka eduze usebenzisa i-loupe end ye-Arclight.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_023: Khanyisa izibani bese uye phezulu eduze kuka-6 cm. Kungase kudingeke ukuthi usebenzise umunwe wakho ukuze uvule amajwabu amehlo ngobumnene.
assessmentVisionPage.cue_024: Zibuze imibuzo ethile. Ingabe ingxenye emhlophe yeso pink noma ebomvu? Ingabe inhlamvu yeso noma i-cornea gray noma imhlophe?
assessmentVisionPage.cue_025: Ingabe inhlamvu yeso uyindilinga? Uyayibona imizimba yangaphandle? Manje usukulungele ukwenza izivivinyo ze-reflex.

mumVisionPage.cue_001: Ngaphakathi esibelethweni, umntwana ongakazalwa uzungezwe imisindo epholile nepholile, kuhlanganise neyakhe
mumVisionPage.cue_002: ukushaya kwenhliziyo kamama nohlelo lokugaya ukudla kanye namazwi nemisindo evela emhlabeni ngaphandle. Njengoba
mumVisionPage.cue_003: ukukhulelwa kufinyelela esigabeni sokugcina, amehlo omntwana angavuleka ngaphakathi esibelethweni. Nakuba bengakwazi
mumVisionPage.cue_004: kodwa babone izithombe noma imininingwane, bangezwa izinguquko ekukhanyeni. Ngakho, kuyilapho ukuphila esibelethweni kuyinto muffled
mumVisionPage.cue_005: futhi kufiphele, kukude nokuthula. Ukuzalwa kuwushintsho olukhulu enganeni. Bangena ngokuphazima kweso
mumVisionPage.cue_006: umhlaba ogcwele izinto ezintsha, ezigqamile nemisindo ephezulu. Ukuzivumelanisa naleli zwe elisha kuyinzwa
mumVisionPage.cue_007: ukuvuka lokho kukhahlela-kuqala ukukhula kwabo. Emasontweni ambalwa okuqala okuphila, ingane izokwenza
mumVisionPage.cue_008: athuke avuke uma kunemisindo ephezulu. Amehlo abo azwela ukukhanya okukhanyayo,
mumVisionPage.cue_009: kodwa basabona okuncane kakhulu. Umbono wabo, nokho, uqala ukukhula ngendlela emangalisayo
mumVisionPage.cue_010: isilinganiso. Phakathi namasonto amabili, umbono usuthuthuke kakhulu. Manje sebengabona imininingwane ethile, ikakhulukazi
mumVisionPage.cue_011: uma izinto ziseduze. Awukho umbala, futhi abakubonayo kuyisicaba ngenxa yamehlo abo
mumVisionPage.cue_012: azikahlale ziqondile futhi zisebenza ndawonye ukuze uthole ukuqonda okujulile. Kwesinye isikhathi amehlo abo
mumVisionPage.cue_013: izokhukhuleka ingene noma iphume isikhashana. Lokhu kubizwa ngokuthi ukuklolodela. Lokhu kufanele kuyeke ukwenzeka
mumVisionPage.cue_014: ngezinyanga ezintathu. Ngenyanga eyodwa, ukubona imibala kuqala ukukhula. Bazoba baningi
mumVisionPage.cue_015: nentshisekelo ebonakalayo, ikakhulukazi ebusweni. Bazoqala futhi ukuzama ukulandela izinto
mumVisionPage.cue_016: ezihambayo. Bazokwazi ngokwengeziwe imisindo ejwayelekile, kuhlanganise neyaziwa kakhulu
mumVisionPage.cue_017: amazwi, njengomndeni wabo, futhi baqale ukuhlanganisa abakuzwayo nabakuzwayo
mumVisionPage.cue_018: bona. Ezinyangeni ezintathu, amehlo azo kufanele ahlale eqondile futhi asebenze ndawonye ukudala
mumVisionPage.cue_019: Umbono we-3D. Lo mbono omusha ojulile ubasiza ukuba bafinyelele izinto ngokunembe kakhudlwana. Bona
mumVisionPage.cue_020: uzokwazi ukulandela izinto ezihamba ngokushesha. Ngesikhathi esifanayo, imisindo enengqondo
mumVisionPage.cue_021: izoqala ukwenziwa. Ezinyangeni eziyisithupha, umntwana kufanele akwazi ukubona abantu abajwayele
mumVisionPage.cue_022: kokubili ubuso namazwi abo. Bangakwazi futhi ukubona izinto ezikude
mumVisionPage.cue_023: kude. Beqhutshwa ilukuluku lokufuna ukwazi, bazofinyelela izinto, bakhase ngakuzo, futhi, bazungeze
mumVisionPage.cue_024: usuku lwabo lokuzalwa lokuqala, ukuhamba ngezinyawo. Ukubhibhidla kwabo kuyakhula futhi imisindo izoba eyokuqala
mumVisionPage.cue_025: amagama kulesi sigaba futhi. Ezinyangeni ezingu-18, umbono usufana nomuntu omdala, nakuba usamile
mumVisionPage.cue_026: ukufiphala kancane. Manje bazokwazi ukubona igama labo futhi basebenzise amagama amaningi.
mumVisionPage.cue_027: Ezinye izingane zingase zingafinyeleli lezi zenzakalo ezibalulekile ngesikhathi esilindelekile. Akhona
mumVisionPage.cue_028: izizathu eziningi zalokhu, futhi abaningi bazozilungisa. Ngokwesibonelo, izingane ezizalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi
mumVisionPage.cue_029: ingase ibe nokubambezeleka, kodwa ngokuvamile itholakala kamuva ebuntwaneni. Kwabanye, kungase kube nokuphikelela
mumVisionPage.cue_030: ubunzima. Ukuhlonza lezi ngokushesha ngangokunokwenzeka ukuze unikeze ukwelashwa nokusekelwa kungakwazi

usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_001: Le vidiyo ichaza indlela yokusebenzisa i-Arclight ukwenza i-fundal reflex ebomvu ngokukhetha isilungiselelo sokukhanya esigqame kakhulu.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_002: Qinisekisa ukuthi i-lens rack iphezulu, lapho kungekho khona amandla e-lens embobeni yokubona.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_003: Ebudeni bengalo, bheka i-reflex kuwo womabili amehlo ngesikhathi esisodwa.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_004: Qhathanisa ukukhanya nombala phakathi kwamehlo amabili.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_005: Ekuhloleni okuvamile, akufanele kube khona umehluko ophelele ekukhanyeni nasembalani phakathi kwamehlo amabili.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_006: Ezinganeni ezimhlophe nase-Asia, i-reflex ingabukeka i-orange futhi iphuzi.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_007: Lokhu kubukeka kusejwayelekile njengoba umbala nokukhanya kuyafana phakathi kwamehlo amabili.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_008: I-reflex engavamile yilapho kunomehluko oqhubekayo, wangempela ekukhanyeni nasembalani phakathi kwamehlo amabili.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_009: Lokhu kungase kube ukuboniswa kwekhoneal okususiwe, indawo emnyama ekhona ngaphakathi kwe-reflex yeso elilodwa noma womabili amehlo, noma i-reflex ebomvu engekho nhlobo.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_010: Ukuhlolwa kwe-reflex okungavamile kungabonisa ukuba khona kwe-cataract, i-retinoblastoma, isibazi se-corneal, i-squint, noma iphutha lokubukeka.
usaidFundalReflexExamPage.cue_011: Konke lokhu kudinga ukuhlolwa okwengeziwe ngochwepheshe.

usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_001: Le vidiyo inikeza isingeniso esifushane kudivayisi ye-Arclight.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_003: Ekuqaleni, zombili iziphetho ze-Arclight zingavela ngasikhathi sinye.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_004: Uma ingakhanyisi nhlobo noma izibani zilufifi, ibhethri lingase libe flat.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_007: Ngemuva kwemizuzu engu-15, kufanele ishajwe ngokugcwele futhi isebenze amahora ambalwa.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_008: Ukuyishiya ekukhanyeni kwelanga kuzogcina ibhethri lishajiwe.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_009: Ngeke udinge ukushintsha noma yimaphi amabhethri noma ama-bulb.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_010: Imodi lapho zombili iziphetho zifika ngeyokusetshenziswa okuvamile.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_011: Shintshela kumodi yamehlo ngokubamba inkinobho phansi imizuzwana engu-15.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_012: Bese uphakamisa iminwe yakho bese ucindezela ngokushesha futhi njengoba ukukhanya kukhanya.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_013: Manje ukumodi yamehlo, lapho kuzovela khona i-ophthalmoscope
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_014: okokuqala, bese kuba i-loupe ingxenye yangaphambili.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_015: Ukuphinda lezi zinyathelo kuzozungeza izindlela ezintathu ezihlukene zokusebenzisa.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_016: Ukusetshenziswa okujwayelekile, amehlo, bese kuba nezindlebe.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_017: Uma usuyikhethile imodi oyincamelayo, ucindezela inkinobho empunga
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_018: kushintsha indlela izibani ezikhanya ngayo nokuthi yikuphi ukuphela okukhanyisiwe.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_019: Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa isiphetho esifanele ukuhlola okulungile.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_021: Ukubuka kuzocaca uma usondelene kakhulu neso cishe ngo-6 cm.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_022: I-fundal reflex yenziwa ngobude bengalo kusetshenziswa i-ophthalmoscope eqondile.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_023: Uma ukubuka kufiphele, bheka ukuthi i-lens rack iphezulu.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_024: Kulesi simo, ayikho ilensi embobeni yokubona futhi i-reflex kufanele icace.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_025: I-Arclight ingasetshenziswa futhi ukuthwebula ividiyo yezimpawu zomtholampilo
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_027: Uma isinamathiselwe, imbobo yokubona ye-ophthalmoscope eqondile
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_028: izobekwa ngokuqondile phakathi nendawo yelensi esetshenziswa ikhamera yakho yeselula kumodi yevidiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_029: Ikhamera izosebenza njengamehlo akho uma ubuka ngembobo yokubona.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_030: Ukuqinisekisa ukuthi iyiphi ilensi ongamisa ngayo imbobo yokubona,
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_031: vula uhlelo lokusebenza lwevidiyo ocingweni lwakho, beka umunwe wakho phezu kwelensi ngayinye ngokushintshana.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_032: Uma isikrini siba mnyama, uvale ilensi esetshenziselwa ividiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_034: Beka amaphoyinti omcibisholo phakathi nendawo yelensi esetshenziselwa ukuthwebula ividiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_037: Isiqeshana kufanele manje sibe sesimweni esifanele.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_038: Ukuze wenze ividiyo ye-reflex, vula i-ophthalmoscope eqondile
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_039: ekugcineni kwe-Arclight bese ukhetha ukukhanya okugqama kakhulu ngokuchofoza kathathu.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_041: Njengoba ukukhanya kubheke kude nefoni kuya esigulini,
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_042: beka i-Arclight kusiqeshana bese udonsa ukunwebeka ukuze uvikeleke.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_043: Phusha i-Arclight phezulu ize ingakwazi ukuslayida ngokuqhubekayo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_045: manje izoba maphakathi nendawo yelensi ethwebula ividiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_046: Ukuze urekhode iso langaphandle, sebenzisa esinye isiphetho sedivayisi.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_047: Ukuze uthwebule izithombe, vula uhlelo lokusebenza lwevidiyo futhi usondeze isithombe,
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_050: Cindezela okuthi misa bese ulondoloza ividiyo.
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_051: Manje usungabelana nozakwenu ezinkundleni zokuxhumana ezivikelekile, ezibethelwe
usaidHowToUseArclightPage.cue_052: kuphela ngenjongo othole ngayo imvume esigulini.

usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_001: Le vidiyo ichaza ukubukeka kwe-fundal red reflex okuvamile nokungajwayelekile.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_002: Ukuhlolwa kwe-reflex ebomvu evamile ye-fundal yilapho ungekho umehluko ophelele ekugqameni nasembalani phakathi kwamehlo amabili anokukhanya kwekhoneal emaphakathi.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_003: Ngisho nokubukeka okuvamile kwe-fundal reflex, noma kunjalo, kuzohluka kuye ngokuthi ukude kangakanani nokuthi ingane ibheke kuphi.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_004: Ukuhlola okusebenzayo lapho kufanele uye ngapha nangapha futhi uye emuva naphambili ngaphakathi naseduze ubude bengalo ukusuka esigulini.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_005: Izingane kanye nezingane nazo zizonyakazisa izandla namehlo, okwenza i-reflex ishintshe indlela ebukeka ngayo ngesikhathi sokuhlolwa.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_006: Enganeni emnyama, i-reflex ngokuvamile ibukeka iphaphathekile, inombala ophuzi nomhlophe futhi ngezinye izikhathi noluhlaza okwesibhakabhaka njengombala oyinhloko.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_007: Okubalulekile, ekuhloleni okuvamile, akufanele kube nomehluko ophelele ekukhanyeni nasembalani phakathi kwamehlo amabili anokubonisa okuphakathi kwekhone.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_008: I-reflex engavamile yilapho kunomehluko oqhubekayo, wangempela ekukhanyeni nasembalani phakathi kwamehlo amabili.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_009: Ukuboniswa kwekhoneal okususiwe, isigaxa esimnyama esikhona ngaphakathi kwe-reflex yeso elilodwa noma womabili amehlo, noma i-reflex ebomvu engekho ngokuphelele.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_010: Ukuhlolwa kwe-reflex okungavamile kungabonisa ukuba khona kwe-cataract, i-retinoblastoma, isibazi se-corneal, i-squint, iphutha le-refractive noma izinkinga zokuzalwa ezifana ne-coloboma.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_011: Konke lokhu kudinga ukuhlolwa okwengeziwe ngochwepheshe.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_012: Bheka lokhu kucabanga bese uzibuza: ingabe lokhu kujwayelekile noma akujwayelekile? Izimpendulo zizolandela kamuva.
usaidNormalAbnormalPage.cue_013: Manje kufanele ube nokuqonda kangcono ukuthi i-reflex evamile ibukeka kanjani, kanye nokukhalipha okungavamile, futhi ukwazi ukuphakamisa imbangela okungenzeka kakhulu.

diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_009: Ngeke udinge ukushintsha noma yimaphi amabhethri noma ama-bulb.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_010: Imodi lapho zombili iziphetho zifika ngeyokusetshenziswa okuvamile.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_011: Shintshela kumodi yamehlo ngokubamba inkinobho phansi imizuzwana engu-15.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_012: Bese uphakamisa iminwe yakho bese ucindezela ngokushesha futhi njengoba ukukhanya kukhanya.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_013: Manje ukumodi yamehlo, lapho kuzovela khona i-ophthalmoscope
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_014: okokuqala, bese kuba i-loupe ingxenye yangaphambili.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_015: Ukuphinda lezi zinyathelo kuzozungeza izindlela ezintathu ezihlukene zokusebenzisa.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_016: Ukusetshenziswa okujwayelekile, amehlo, bese kuba nezindlebe.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_017: Uma usukhethile imodi oyincamelayo, ucindezela inkinobho empunga
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_018: kushintsha indlela izibani ezikhanya ngayo nokuthi yikuphi ukuphela okukhanyisiwe.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_019: Qiniseka ukuthi usebenzisa isiphetho esifanele ukuhlola okulungile.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_021: Ukubuka kuzocaca uma usondelene kakhulu neso cishe ngo-6 cm.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_022: I-fundal reflex yenziwa ngobude bengalo kusetshenziswa i-ophthalmoscope eqondile.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_023: Uma ukubuka kufiphele, bheka ukuthi i-lens rack iphezulu.
diabeticIntroductionToArclightVideoPage.cue_024: Kulesi simo, ayikho ilensi embobeni yokubona futhi i-reflex kufanele icace.
